prompt.alinti: This new open-source IDE lets you run multiple cloud-code agents at the same time, each one working inside its own isolated copy of your repo.
It's called Orca, and it lets you run multiple coding tasks in parallel instead of waiting for one agent to finish before starting the next.
Each agent gets its own Git worktree so they can build separate features without overriding each other.
Everything is managed from one dashboard where you can track tasks, review work, or set up automation using prompts and templates.
And because it works on desktop and mobile, you can manage everything on the go.
So wanna check it out? Just comment 'code' and I will send you the link.
